title: Megurine Luka — Take A New Angle〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I want to tell her that it's okay to run...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Or shout, “Run!”
“It's okay to run away from this place!”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And that there's a safe place where you can run to...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (It appears that Mizuki was able to get all those feelings across...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (So, things should get very interesting.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Will Mafuyu choose to break free from her shackles, or...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Voice
rows.Line: Luka!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Mizuki, welcome.
Oh, Len, Rin? You came together?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe. There's something I wanna give to you, Luka♪ Ta-daa!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hm? A pink Swiss roll?
It looks delicious, and the fruits on top look are a nice touch.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: They apparently mixed this strawberry sauce into the cake batter. It was so pretty and pink that you immediately came to mind, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I wanted to get you something as thanks for the advice you gave me the other day♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I was invited to go along since I also helped a little...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes, I see.
So, Rin, where does that put you?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I just happened to be there when Mizuki invited Len.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Which means... You're just here to have some of this Swiss roll?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So what if I am? Mizuki already said I could.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Anyway, allow me to once again...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Thank you, Luka!
I feel a lot better now because of what you said.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That's good to hear. By the way...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: If the time ever comes, I'll be more than happy to burst your bubble.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Huh? Haha...
Alright, if the time comes.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Enough with that...
We're here to have cake, not have another weird chat.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
True.
Then, I'd like to have some of this.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Mizuki, the paper plates are ready...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Thanks, here's your slice!
And here are yours, Luka, Len!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Ah, thank you.
Oh...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Len, your slice looks a little bigger than mine...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Huh? I-It does?
Then, wanna trade...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Don't trade with her.
She's just teasing you.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, you saw right through me.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Wait, you were just joking...?
Th-Thank goodness...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. They cut it at the shop, so I'm pretty sure they're all the same size. If anything, what fruits you get on top is gonna differ at most.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wait, huh...?! They didn't give us any forks!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It is a Swiss roll. We could just use our hands.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You sure? I do have napkins so feel free to use as many as you want.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Anyway...

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Let's eat!
Let's eat.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Mmm... This is amazing!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: The cranberries are pretty sour, but it goes really well with the whipped cream's sweetness!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The strawberry flavoring for the cake itself is also very nice.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah. And it's so fluffy...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Len, you have some whipped cream on your nose...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh? Oh no...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You say that, Rin, but your hands are covered in whipped cream.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Mizuki, would you mind handing us some napkins?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Right away!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Thank you, Mizuki...
Here you two. Clean yourselves up.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Thanks, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: There's actually enough cake for everyone. Do you think Miku and the others would want some?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, I could go deliver some to them.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You say that but you're planning on eating all of it, aren't you...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Would you like to join me, Rin, Len?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha! If you're gonna form a secret pact, you gotta do it when I'm not here.

rows.Speaker: Luka & Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Haha.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe.
